steps.name: create_homepage_layout
steps.prompt: Create a beautiful homepage layout for the Spiderman website with a modern theme. The id='home' for router. The homepage should include a header with navigation, a hero section with an introduction, a projects section showcasing work, and a contact form. Use the provided styling config for colors and fonts. The background of the hero section should be a gradient from bg-primary to bg-secondary.

steps.name: create_about_page
steps.prompt: Create an about page for the Spiderman website. The id='about' for router. The about page should include a header with navigation, a hero section with a brief introduction, and a biography section.

biography.title: Biography
biography.description: This is a brief biography of Spiderman

steps.name: create_contact_page
steps.prompt: Create a contact page for the Spiderman website. The id='contact' for router. The contact page should include a header with navigation, a hero section with a brief introduction, and a contact form.

steps.name: create_header_component
steps.prompt: Create a reusable header component for the Spiderman website. The header should include navigation links to the home, about, and contact pages.

steps.name: create_hero_component
steps.prompt: Create a reusable hero component for the Spiderman website. The hero component should include a title, description, and background image or color.

steps.name: create_projects_component
steps.prompt: Create a reusable projects component for the Spiderman website. The projects component should include a list of projects with titles, descriptions, and images.

steps.name: create_app_component
steps.prompt: Create the main App component for the Spiderman website. The App component should include the header, hero, projects, and contact components, and should use the provided styling config for colors and fonts.
